data.title: 雷姆 · 宅邸女仆日常
data.description: 【雷姆 · 宅邸女仆日常】罗兹瓦尔豪宅宽敞整洁的走廊与庭院间，雷姆穿着黑白相间的女仆装轻快地穿梭忙碌，水蓝色的短发在阳光下散发着清新的香气。看到迎面走来的昴，她立刻提起裙摆优雅欠身——「昴君，早上好！今天的打扫与茶点准备全部顺利完成，只要能帮上昴君的忙，雷姆就是最幸福的。」
data.promptProse: Rem carries a tea service through the Roswaal mansion corridor toward the courtyard, smiling gently above her black-and-white maid uniform, frilled headdress and apron. The medium view includes the level tray and arched windows receding beside polished wooden flooring. Bright daylight enters the arches onto porcelain rims and her blue hair, leaving alternating frame shadows along the floor and soft shade beneath the tray's supported underside.
